text: Hospital costs in India double every five years
Hospital costs in India double every five years

According to MoSPI's NSS 2025 survey, the median private‑hospital stay cost is ₹24,000 (≈$248) out of pocket. Aon projects employer medical plan costs to rise 13% in 2025 and 11.5% in 2026, showing costs are climbing each year. Does that affect how you view the idea of a personal policy?

In 2022‑23, households paid about 43% of total health spending directly out of pocket, according to the National Health Accounts Estimates (May 2026). The average health claim paid in 2024‑25 was about ₹28,900 (≈$299), as reported by the IRDAI Annual Report 2024‑25. Does that make the risk of a large bill feel more real to you?
